purpose: Machine-readable correction to the v1.0 clean-room target. This file defines a negative audit result, not a replacement positive factoring-runtime claim.

required_rns_conditions.modular_deviation: min(L mod N, N - (L mod N)) < N >> min_wraparound_gap

historical_v1_prime_selection.rule: Enumerate primes in [2^19, 2^20), sort descending, and take the shortest prefix whose floating-point sum(log2(p)) is at least 499712.
historical_v1_prime_selection.canonical_list_encoding: ASCII decimal, one prime per line, trailing newline

reproduction_pseudocode: Read N from Gidney's frozen testdata/rsa2048.ini.
Independently enumerate the v1 descending 20-bit prime prefix.
Compute L_mod_N incrementally as L_mod_N = (L_mod_N * p) mod N.
Assert centered < (N >> 31). The assertion fails with the values recorded above.

affected_claims.C1: Survives only as an abstract same-workload scheduler ablation; it is not a factoring-runtime result.
affected_claims.C2: Withdrawn. The schedule is internally feasible for a size-only synthetic workload, but the workload does not instantiate the claimed approximate-residue factoring computation.
affected_claims.C3: Not established and cannot be tested until C2 is repaired.

additional_corrections.inherited_assumption_1: A suitable low-deviation prime set can be found in expected O(2^f * poly(m * bitlength(N))) time by random variation.
additional_corrections.inherited_assumption_2: A mask covering proportion S can be costed by multiplying expected shots by 1 / (1 - S).
additional_corrections.warning: The post-processing arithmetic correction does not produce a valid factoring runtime because the RNS instance remains invalid.

replacement_requirements: Publish an explicit modulus-specific prime set and canonical hash.
Verify product capacity against N^num_windows1, not only a bit-length surrogate.
Verify the strict modular-deviation threshold against the actual RSA modulus.
Verify all periods are distinct primes of the claimed width and divide no required multiplier.
Generate or deterministically derive every modulus-specific lookup table.
Rebuild the workload, schedule, resource peaks, failure multiplier, and runtime if any count or width changes.
Issue a new versioned positive reproduction specification; do not reactivate v1.0 acceptance.

acceptance.erratum_reproduced_when: An independent implementation derives the same 25,330-prime prefix and demonstrates that its centered product residue is not less than N >> 31.
